question: Should this mandatory release-ledger gate land before its authoritative historical reconciliation, with every regular publication path blocked until the exact landed trusted-main run passes?
rationale: The implementation deliberately includes landed trusted-main tooling identity in the immutable evidence, so code review cannot choose the merge-first proof sequence or accept its fail-closed operational dependency on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Land, reconcile, then publish
options.body: Merge the reviewed stack, immediately execute the ledger on the exact landed tooling SHA, and prohibit regular publication until every validation passes.

options.title: Hold for current-head rehearsal
options.body: Keep the draft open until a non-authoritative current-head run proves the real historical reconciliation and all three consumer paths.

options.title: Pause ledger enforcement
options.body: Defer the mandatory gate if release operators cannot reliably generate, retain, and recover its artifact.

recommendation.title: Land, reconcile, then publish
recommendation.body: Merge the reviewed stack, immediately execute the ledger on the exact landed tooling SHA, and prohibit regular publication until every validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the final publication gates and current-head provenance hydration and has the strongest recent history across the affected release paths.
